about_the_game:
ENVIRONMENT DEMO

Vuntra City is a city exploration game where every building can be entered. The full game is currently in development, so this demo only showcases the procedural city environment and does not feature the full range of gameplay planned for the final release.

There are currently no goals or missions in the demo, so just turn on your favorite podcast or playlist and enjoy a relaxing and immersive city walk.

The demo can be played in VR or flat screen with keyboard & mouse as well as gamepad.

NOTE

This is a project in active development, so there may be bugs and unfinished mechanics. Feel free to join the discord linked on the sidebar to share your feedback and suggestions.

DEMO FEATURES

  • A vast (20x20km) fully procedural city to explore with complete player freedom, generated from a custom seed.

  • Immersive mechanics such as being able to take the elevator to any floor, sit on every piece of furniture, and pick up any item.

  • Interactive items such as maps and info terminals that help you navigate the city and reveal some of its lore.

  • Scenic transport options to traverse the city, such as self driving cars and sky trams.

  • Day and night cycle and weather changes.

COMING IN THE FULL GAME

  • NPCs with schedules and a reactive dialog system.

  • NPC factions that the player will be able to join and advance in, each with a unique story and progression.

  • Space ownership and customization mechanics.

  • More interior and exterior variety, including underground spaces and tunnels, overground walkways and plazas, unique buildings, and more.

  • More transport options, including manually controlled vehicles.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 HQ
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070 (Flat screen), GeForce RTX 2080 (VR)
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR, SteamVR, Valve Index, Meta Quest 2, Oculus Rift S
